title: Large personal native editor, tape tool and reconstruction discovery
summary: Personally screen 394 candidate URLs and add 26 projects, with six explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root assistant personally screened 24 search routes plus primary-source related projects, inspected README and implementation, and prepared direct-main publication without a worker, PR or branch. Scope includes MSX Gradius and Apple II animation reconstruction, native Commodore editors, Apple II IDE/media tooling, and Spectrum/ZX81/BK tape conversion. Fork duplicates, irrelevant waveform software, a thin cp2 frontend, unrelated homebrew and unfabricated hardware are distinguished. Snapcheck rules are not implemented, Wizardry editing is incomplete, and decoder format restrictions are explicit. No upstream builds or runtime tests were performed. pyhsb uses a small Z80 interpreter for runtime emission and ROM arithmetic; its explicit AI authorship is recorded. Large or encoding-mismatched files retain immutable links rather than rewritten proof excerpts.

sources.reason: Self-hosted control interface integrates sector-chain D64/D71/D81 extraction, DMA loading, screen/audio streaming and device operation queues.
Reads directories, follows file chains, manipulates BAM allocation, imports/exports files and formats D64 images.
Annotated DEMOLIB disassembly identifies RLE image unpacking and even/odd-byte color-cycling animation used by Martin Kahn artwork hidden on Print Shop Color disks.
Parses SZX snapshots, reports register/RAM state and loads map-file symbols as groundwork for external game assertions.
Preserves a 1994 WIMP frontend and modified SPConv conversion engine with drag/drop and RISC OS filetype handling.
Sixteen-bank Konami4 disassembly uses whole-cartridge and per-bank control-flow tracing, anchored notes, graphics extraction and cross-checks for code/data conflicts.
Implements PsyTexx1 MOD/PDB playback and WAV output with echo, filters and nonstandard effects encoded in module/sample names.
Schema-driven acquisition pipelines stage flux/images, photos, metadata and hashed manifests with separate CLI and PySide6 catalogue views.
Routine-oriented Python reconstruction of HiSoft BASIC1.1/1.2 code generation emits Z80 code and TAP loaders, with original-style compilation passes and directives.
Native editor provides pixel changes, shifts/rotate/mirror, clipboard, undo/redo, font loading/saving and raster-based character-set selection.
Native source maps scenario-disk sectors to character buffers, displays names/classes/age and unpacks/re-packs packed attributes.
Reverse-engineered Questron save state enables editing stats, HP, gold and food for four character slots in a native C64 program.
VSCode extension integrates machine emulation, pixel editing, BASIC/source conversion and transactional DOS3.3/ProDOS image access.
Browser editor builds a fixed 8-by-7 monochrome grid and exports reversed-bit binary, hexadecimal and decimal rows for source data.
Converts TAP blocks to audio pilot, synchronization and data pulses with adjustable output rate, gain and inter-block gaps; native and WASM entry points.
Combines libspectrum TZX rendering and p2raw-derived T81 encoding with coroutine-based sample generation and SDL2 direct playback.
Win32 PCM audio reader and converter recover Spectrum TAP data from recorded waveforms with channel selection.
Flutter/Dart library parses TAP and multiple TZX block types, builds WAV bytes and offers audio filter/writer paths.
Library and CLI parse TAP and selected TZX tone/data/pause/metadata blocks and generate WAV with optional checksum validation.
Linux waveform demodulator detects carrier/pilot/sync and adapts pulse classes to recover tape bytes into TZX standard blocks.
Classifies waveform pulse lengths, assembles MSB-first bytes and writes length-prefixed Spectrum TAP blocks.
Reads TAP blocks and synthesizes pilot/sync/data pulses directly to a selected Java Sound output with volume control.
Converts images into PETSCII screen/color data, BASIC and BBS output, plus Koala and Hi-Eddi formats with palette and dithering controls.
Native BASIC drawing tool maps quarter-character pixels to screen codes, supports full-screen editing, in-memory backup and tape save/load.
Native character editor supports pixel transforms, clipboard and undo/redo within unexpanded VIC-20 RAM.
Converts emulator BIN header/data into BK tape WAV with checksum, filename/address overrides and double-frequency turbo option.

Primary material is a reverse-engineered TTL video card with KiCad design and BOM; upstream explicitly has not fabricated it. Retain for a hardware-specific catalogue decision rather than misclassify it as software or firmware.

Inspected engine delegates all ProDOS operations to already tracked CiderPress II cp2 and parses its catalogue output. Useful workflow frontend, but no independent filesystem implementation warrants a separate discovery promotion in this batch.

Inspected BASIC source is an original 2021 homebrew platform game, not recovery of a historical title or reusable development tool. Retain source decision without presenting it as reverse engineering.

Repository metadata identifies a fork of tracked boriel-basic/zxbasic and README still describes upstream. A renamed fork and numerous platform documents alone do not establish a separate implemented compiler.
Repository metadata identifies a fork of tracked mdoege/IFFshow; inspected README and Python decoder retain the same viewer/converter identity. No independent project established.

README and Swift AudioDecoder identify a modern general SwiftUI audio visualization package, not Spectrum tape recovery or retro development tooling. Search matched generic spectrum/tap/WAV terminology.
